cues: Growth is a permanent, irreversible increase in size, volume or dry weight.
A wilted leaf that perks up after watering has not grown: that was only turgor coming back.
In plants, growth is confined to the meristems, and it is indeterminate: a tree keeps adding organs as long as it lives.
